parts.title: Separate knowledge from proof
parts.body: Create a matrix with strategy, finance, AI systems, evaluation, governance, security, data, organizational change, and board communication. For each area, record your confidence from 1 to 5 and one concrete piece of evidence: a project shipped, a decision memo, a review chaired, or a result measured. Knowing the vocabulary is different from being able to show an outcome.
parts.label: Understand

parts.title: Build your first evidence plan
parts.body: For a technical director, architecture and team leadership may already have strong examples. Regulatory judgment or companywide investment allocation may need new evidence. Pick two weak areas and design a small artifact for each, such as a governance playbook and a portfolio decision memo. Set a date for a knowledgeable reviewer to challenge them.
parts.label: Apply
